audit.whatIsWrong: The lane text ran on male pronouns for Katarina and described an 'orbiting stars' Aurelion Sol that no longer exists.
audit.why: Current kit is Breath of Light (750, 3s), Astral Flight (22/20.5/19/17.5/16s), Singularity (750, 12s) and Falling Star (120/110/100s). Katarina's reach is Shunpo at 725.
audit.corrected: Difficulty stays 7/10 and stays hers through the first item; the lane is a spacing problem at 750 against a 725 blink.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers on the last three rows: phases[4..6].side all read 'Skill' against win[4]='Katarina', win[5]='Katarina', win[6]='Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Katarina for six rows then Aurelion Sol at two items, matching the content layer.
audit.corrected: Full layer set to Katarina / Katarina / Aurelion Sol as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction was stated backwards: spikes[1] and mid both claimed you have no interrupt for Death Lotus, and wants.you[1] told the player to save 'Voidlink (E)' — an ability Aurelion Sol does not have.
audit.why: Death Lotus is flagged 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Falling Star is flagged hardCC. Your R stuns her out of her own ultimate.
audit.corrected: Rewritten everywhere it appeared: Falling Star is the interrupt, and at 6 the lane reduces to whether your R is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Shunpo as matchup-defining without a single number.
audit.why: Shunpo 12/11/10/9/8s at 725 range; Bouncing Blade 11/10/9/8/7s at 625; Death Lotus 75/60/45s at 550.
audit.corrected: Concrete windows written in, keyed to the cooldown she just spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Voracity was never named, though it is why a kill anywhere on the map resets her whole combo.
audit.why: Passive: when an enemy champion she recently damaged dies, her remaining cooldowns are dramatically reduced.
audit.corrected: Written into enemyWin, breakdown.feeding, ahead and spikes[2].

edits.before: Levels 1-2 already favor Katarina since her dagger-reset trading pattern lets her poke and reset E for free while your stars are still too spread out to threaten her, and by levels 3-5 her full W-E combo turns any misstep into a kill since your stacked stars still don't hit hard enough to punish her dive.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 favor Katarina: Bouncing Blade costs her no mana, Shunpo refunds itself off her own daggers, and your beam has to hold 750 range to do anything at all. By levels 3-5 her Preparation-into-Shunpo pattern turns any misstep into a kill, so farm from the back of the wave with Singularity and take only the CS you can reach.

edits.before: Level 6 is her spike into a genuine lane-ending threat: Death Lotus channels enormous true-ish damage in an AoE and you have no hard CC or displacement reliably up to stop it, so any roam or gank she gets access to turns into a guaranteed kill unless you play with maximum spacing.
edits.after: Level 6 is her spike and also yours: Death Lotus is a 550-range channel on 75s and Falling Star's stun cancels it outright. The lane reduces to one question — is your R up? If it is, hold it for her channel and nothing else. If it is not, keep 750 between you and refuse the fight.

edits.before: Your first item still doesn't flip the burst math in your favor since her reset combo kills faster than your stacked stars can answer, and it's only once you're fully scaled with a stacked orbit and your ultimate online that your range and damage finally outclass her dive, letting you punish her positioning in teamfights instead of feeding her resets.
edits.after: Your first item does not flip the burst math: any kill on the map refunds her cooldowns, and she kills faster than a beam rotation lands. It is at two items, with Stardust banked and The Skies Descend online, that your 750 range and Singularity's execute finally outclass a 725-range blink — punish her positioning instead of feeding resets.

edits.before: Katarina's Bouncing Blade-Death Lotus combo threat starts as soon as she has W-E reset access, and your stars can't deal with her dagger resets fast enough to trade evenly in this window.
edits.after: Katarina's dagger-into-Shunpo pattern is online at 3 and costs her no mana, while every second of beam costs you 35-55 — you cannot trade back until Astral Flight gives you the flyby at 4.

edits.before: Death Lotus is a full lane-ending threat once she has any kill pressure from roams or a jungler gank, and your kit has no hard interrupt to stop the channel outside of your own E displacement, which you often don't have up in time.
edits.after: Death Lotus is a 550-range channel on a 75s cooldown, and Falling Star's stun is a clean interrupt to it, so 6 comes down to one question: if your R is up her all-in is a fight she loses, and if it is down, spacing is the only answer.

edits.before: Even with your first item online, her dagger-reset burst combo still one-shots you faster than your stacked stars can answer, so this remains her window.
edits.after: Even on your first item, a kill anywhere on the map refunds her cooldowns, so her combo still outpaces a full Breath of Light rotation here.

edits.before: Only once you're fully scaled with stacked stars and your ultimate does your damage and range finally outclass her all-in burst, letting you punish her positioning before she can reach you.
edits.after: At two items your banked Stardust and The Skies Descend finally outrange her 725 blink, so you punish her positioning from 750 long before Death Lotus gets inside 550 range.

edits.before: Save Voidlink (E) specifically to escape her Death Lotus channel range
edits.after: Save Falling Star specifically to stun her out of the Death Lotus channel
